title: Normalized constant left-module inverse-image lift
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\Lambda$ be a unital ring, not necessarily commutative. Write $\Lambda_J,\Lambda_K$ for its sheafified constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $\operatorname{Modules}(J,\Lambda)=\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_J)$ and similarly for $K$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $L:\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathrm{Set})\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Sh}(K,\mathrm{Set}):R$ be a specified adjunction, with $L$ preserving finite limits. A normalized constant-left-module inverse-image lift of this adjunction is the following datum. It contains an isomorphism $c:L(\underline\Lambda_J)\cong |\Lambda_K|$ and an isomorphism $p:L(\underline{*}_J)\cong\underline{*}_K$. After the canonical constant-sheaf/forgetful identifications, $c$ carries the ring addition and multiplication transported by $L$ and its inverse binary-product comparison to those on $\Lambda_K$, and for each $r\in\Lambda$ it satisfies $c\circ L(\underline r)=\underline r\circ p$. It contains functors $F:\operatorname{Modules}(J,\Lambda)\to\operatorname{Modules}(K,\Lambda)$ and $G$ in the opposite direction, an adjunction $F\dashv G$, additivity of $F$, and preservation of finite limits and finite colimits by $F$. It also contains functors $B:\operatorname{Ab}(J)\to\operatorname{Ab}(K)$ and $B'$ in the opposite direction, an adjunction $B\dashv B'$, and natural underlying-set identifications $|B(-)|\cong L(|-|)$ and $|B'(-)|\cong R(|-|)$. The first identification carries the addition transported by $L$ and the inverse binary-product comparison to addition on $B(-)$. Forgetting these identifications carries the unit of $B\dashv B'$ to the given unit of $L\dashv R$. Finally, writing $V_J,V_K$ for forgetting scalars to abelian sheaves, the datum contains natural isomorphisms $V_KF\cong BV_J$ and $V_JG\cong B'V_K$, and a natural set isomorphism $|F(-)|\cong L(|-|)$ equal to the composite of the first of these with the underlying-set identification of $B$. Under $V_KF\cong BV_J$, multiplication by every constant scalar $r$ on $F(M)$ agrees with applying $B$ to multiplication by $r$ on $M$. Under the two scalar-forgetting isomorphisms the unit of $F\dashv G$ agrees with that of $B\dashv B'$. Sectionwise addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication in these conditions mean the actual operations on the displayed sheaves. This defines a type of normalized lifts, without asserting that this type is inhabited.
